# Ivan Alvovsky (Иван Альвовский)

> Strategy, investment and corporate development. Saint Petersburg. Builds the missing instruments for decisions where there are none yet: financial models, market data, protocols, evaluation criteria.

Russian: Иван Альвовский: стратегия, инвестиции, корпоративное развитие. Строит недостающие инструменты для решений, где их ещё нет.

## Facts
- Clinical development at BIOCAD (oncology, phase I-III trials).
- Ran the project office behind a Leningrad Oblast investor portal: authority response time to investors cut from 30 to 7 working days (sources: https://lenobl.ru/ru/dlya-smi/news/55398/ , https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/6297902 ).
- Strategy, due diligence and M&A support; investment analysis.
- Author of patent RU 2771080 and 4 scientific publications.
- B.Sc. Molecular Medicine, Medizinische Universität Innsbruck. Languages: EN, DE, RU.
